info.name: Catfact Ninja API - Automated Tests
info.description:
Catfact Ninja API — Automated Tests

Author: Yanda Kiviet

This collection contains three automated API tests developed using Postman to validate the Catfact Ninja API.

Test Coverage:

- TC-01: Retrieve a random cat fact and validate its response and maximum length.
    
- TC-02: Retrieve a limited list of cat facts and validate the returned records.
    
- TC-03: Retrieve a limited list of cat breeds and validate the response data.
    

Setup and Execution:

1. Import the collection into Postman Desktop.
    
2. Confirm that the collection variable baseUrl is set to [https://catfact.ninja](https://catfact.ninja/).
    
3. No authentication or API key is required.
    
4. Open the Collection Runner.
    
5. Select Functional, Local, and 1 iteration.
    
6. Select all three requests and click Start run.
    
7. Review the automated test results.
    

Expected Result: All three tests pass when the API returns responses that meet the defined assertions.
